dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a distinct concave curvature (falcate) starting from the apex and extending to the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology at the highest vertical point with a medium pixel radius transition.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Moderately shallow anterior margin with an approximate 35-degree slope relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.8:1 ratio of maximum horizontal base width to maximum vertical height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive distribution of white linear rake marks and punctate depigmentation across the entire lateral surface of the fin and visible dorsal region.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly mottled skin texture with dense white scarring typical of heavy intraspecific interactions.
